title: Immersive robotic teleoperation haptic demo poster
Valkyrie Industries Bifrost Demo
description: Valkyrie Bifrost creates the haptic sensations in the fingers, when touching virtual objects, and muscle haptics creates sensations of weight, when grabbing virtual objects. The glove tracks the fingers and creates haptic sensations using wide-band solenoids, the sleeve creates electrical muscle stimulation on 10 different muscles. Demo created by Ivan in 2019
